survival_rate_basis.note: P_std is denominated in pairs per 10,000 post-screen prompts. No pre-screen conversion is applied anywhere in this arithmetic.

guardrail_diagnostics.note: Measured against HANDOFF §5.1's reference values and NOT applied. These thresholds are absent from frozen §2; applying them would move the §2.6 gate on unregistered rules. If either would have bound materially, register it by amendment before the calibration run.

gate_note: §2.6's decision table decides on the committed CALIBRATION artifact only. This is a pilot: an operational gate the owner reads a histogram for. No Phase 2 decision is emitted here, because the frozen text does not authorize one from 100 prompts.
